desc: Wherever the day takes you, range or field, the 52" Muddy Shotgun Case is built to protect your firearm. It is crafted from rugged, abrasion- and water-resistant 600 denier fabric to shield against the elements, while a thick padded foam interior cushions your shotgun. A spacious exterior pocket keeps ammo, choke tubes and essential shooting gear organized and within reach. Offered in Mossy Oak Bottomland camo and Peat Moss.
